incoterms.title: Incoterms
incoterms.subtitle: We work with all major trade terms

fob.title: FOB
fob.description: Free On Board — seller delivers goods onto the vessel. Buyer bears shipping costs and risk from that point.

cif.title: CIF
cif.description: Cost, Insurance & Freight — seller covers costs and insurance to destination port. Buyer takes risk at origin port.

exw.title: EXW
exw.description: Ex Works — buyer collects goods from seller's premises and bears all costs and risks.

fcl.title: FCL (Full Container Load)
fcl.description: Dedicated 20' or 40' containers for larger orders.

lcl.title: LCL (Less than Container Load)
lcl.description: Shared container space for smaller shipments.

reefer.title: Reefer Containers
reefer.description: Temperature-controlled containers for perishable FMCG goods.

hero.subtitle: Marassi Group has built long-term partnerships with importers, distributors, wholesalers, and retailers by delivering reliable sourcing, export support, and FMCG product solutions across global markets.

story.paragraph1: Founded in 1996, Marassi Group began with a clear vision — to become a trusted link between quality FMCG manufacturers and global markets. From our early days as a sourcing partner to becoming a fully integrated export and private label solutions provider, we have grown through commitment, reliability, and customer success.
story.paragraph2: Today, we work with leading brands and suppliers to deliver a wide range of FMCG products to more than 50 markets worldwide, ensuring consistent quality, competitive pricing, and dependable service.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: To connect the world with quality FMCG products through trusted sourcing, efficient export solutions, and long-term partnerships that create value for our clients.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To be a leading global FMCG export partner recognized for excellence, reliability, and innovation in connecting brands with markets worldwide.

stat.caption: Different products. One container. One commercial invoice. One arrival.

benefits.heading: Why choose mixed shipments?
benefits.description: The traditional "one product per container" model forces you to commit to volume you can't sell or sample products you can't try. Mixed shipments solve both.

products.title: Up to 50 Products in One Container
products.description: Combine multiple FMCG categories — food, beverages, household, personal care — in a single optimized shipment.

moq.title: Smaller MOQ per SKU
moq.description: Lower minimum quantity per product means you can test new lines without committing to a full container of one item.

timeToShelf.title: Faster Time to Shelf
timeToShelf.description: One consolidated booking, one set of documents, one arrival. No need to coordinate dozens of suppliers separately.

loading.title: Optimized Loading
loading.description: Supervised palletization ensures maximum cube utilization and product safety throughout the voyage.

specs.heading: Container capacity
specs.description: Choose the size that matches your volume. Our team helps you maximize fill rate without exceeding weight limits.

shoppingList.title: Share your shopping list

loadingPlan.title: We optimize the loading plan
loadingPlan.desc: Pallets, cartons per layer, weight distribution, and cold-chain segregation if reefer is needed.

invoice.title: Single consolidated invoice
invoice.desc: One commercial invoice, one packing list, one bill of lading. Simple documentation for customs.

supervisedLoading.title: Supervised loading at our warehouse
supervisedLoading.desc: Our 4,000 m² facility in Doral ensures every container is loaded under supervision before sealing.

tracking.title: Tracking & arrival
tracking.desc: Online tracking updates from departure to discharge port. Direct contact with our export team for every step.

cta.description: Send us your shopping list or start with our Quick Order paste tool — we'll come back with a loaded container plan and quote within 48 hours.
